name: Chess Tactics

actions.submit_move: Submit exactly one legal UCI move as {"move":"e2e4"}. Promotions append q, r, b or n.

evaluation.efficiency: Exactly one Player response per episode.
evaluation.failure: Any other or malformed move fails the episode immediately.
evaluation.success: The submitted move is the unique exhaustively verified move that forces checkmate within the stated horizon.

assignment.generation: Nine new legal FEN positions selected from deterministic legal playouts: six unique mate-in-one and three unique forced-mate-in-two positions.
assignment.observation: The full 8x8 board, FEN, side to move, mate horizon and UCI action format are public. There is no hidden state and no opponent model call.
assignment.reference: Self-proposed perfect-information board task built from standard chess legality and checkmate rules. The nine replacement FEN positions were exhaustively verified with python-chess 1.11.2; all construction and sampling choices are reconstruction designs.
assignment.task: Given a complete legal chess position and a stated mate horizon, submit the unique first move that forces checkmate within that horizon.
assignment.verification: Re-enumerate every legal root move with python-chess 1.11.2; for mate-in-two, quantify over every legal defender reply and require an attacking mate reply. Retain FEN, accepted move and proof output.

notes: Replacement instances are pinned in instances.json; task rules, scoring, action budget, model and rendering logic are preserved. Drivers reject old provider/ID/hash selectors.

nativeInstanceFingerprint is SHA-256 of recursively key-sorted JSON of the full instance. substantiveIdentityHash omits seed, ID and private witness (chess uses the position and horizon). configurationHash covers taskId, id, selector and nativeInstanceFingerprint.
